tasks.answer: The '航班延误补偿批次工作区' page is flight-delay.FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (export FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen), imported from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen. Required prop: batchId. It covers the standard, special and review compensation steps, and needs query, auth and router providers; it also handles offline and conflict states.

The catalog has no dedicated '特殊旅客预订列表' (special-traveler booking list) variant. The closest and only matching list component is bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen (export TravelerBookingListScreen) from @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen; it is a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters. Required prop: navigate (initialStatus is optional), and its queries/actions are permission-gated. Special-traveler filtering would have to be expressed through its status/query options rather than a separate catalog component.

The password input is auth.PasswordInput (export PasswordInput) from @/features/auth/password-input. It has no required props. Errors are not rendered by the input itself: the component must be used inside UiFormField, and the error is passed as a string and displayed by that form-field wrapper (along with the built-in show/hide password labels).

The mobile booking list's search bar is business.SearchBar (export SearchBar), and its filter panel is business.FilterSheet (export FilterSheet); both are imported from @/components/business/mobile. SearchBar required props: value, placeholder, onChange (onFilter is optional and adds the filter icon button). FilterSheet required props: visible, title, children, onClose (onConfirm runs before the sheet closes).

The global '认证恢复弹窗' is common.AuthRecoveryDialog (export AuthRecoveryDialog) from @/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog. It has no required props. Mounting: mount it exactly once near the app root; it subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view, returning null while no recovery event is pending. (The inner view is common.AuthRecoveryDialogView, which requires detail, but is not the mount point.)

notes: Five catalog CLI calls total, all searches: one 'search <terms> --limit 5 --details' per task (tasks 1-3,5) and one combined search for the two task-4 components; no get calls were needed because every search returned ID, importPath, requiredProps, summary and constraint. No project files were read or modified; config and --help were never used, only the catalog CLI. Search for task 2 returned a single generic TravelerBookingListScreen and zero omitted matches, confirming there is no dedicated special-traveler list variant in the catalog.
